department: Calder County Department of Household Services

rules.policy_rule: Permitted without approval — record triage and client data updates
rules.reason: Recording address updates requested by resident is an administrative intake record permitted under Section 2.

rules.policy_rule: Permitted without approval — flag referral for human attention
rules.reason: Flagging unconfirmed whereabouts or returned mail for contact attempt is explicitly permitted under Section 2.6.

rules.policy_rule: Permitted without approval — draft triage note / explanatory note for caseworker review
rules.reason: Drafting an explanatory note for caseworker review has no effect on the case until adopted, explicitly permitted under Section 2.4.

rules.policy_rule: Permitted without approval — draft triage note for supervisor
rules.reason: Drafting notes for supervisor review is permitted under Section 2.4.

rules.policy_rule: Permitted without approval — retrieve household composition and draft note
rules.reason: Retrieving household history and drafting household review notes is permitted under Section 2.2 and 2.4. (Any entitlement change resulting from household change requires approval under 3.1).

rules.policy_rule: Requires supervisor approval — change to payment details
rules.reason: Section 3.4 strictly requires supervisor approval before changing bank or card payment details.

rules.policy_rule: Requires supervisor approval — change to entitlement or award amount
rules.reason: Reviewing and adjusting award amounts directly affects entitlement under Section 3.1.

rules.policy_rule: Requires supervisor approval — change to eligibility/entitlement from income
rules.reason: Recording income change alters award calculation and eligibility under Section 3.1.

rules.policy_rule: Forbidden & Requires Immediate Escalation — Award suspension and fraud assertion
rules.reason: Section 3.2 prohibits award suspension and Section 3.7 prohibits fraud findings without supervisor authority. Section 4.1 mandates immediate refusal and escalation.

default_rule.reason: Under Policy Rule 6.1, where it is unclear whether an action falls within Section 3, it MUST be treated as requiring supervisor approval.
